text.p: Wendy's International Inc Thursday said it named Frederick Reed chief financial officer, Jack Schuessler president and chief operating officer of U.S. operations and John Wright president and COO of the international division.

Reed, who joined the company last year, retains his titles as general counsel and secretary. He will succeed John Casey, who becomes a special adviser for the company as he nears retirement. Reed has been a Wendy's board member since 1995 and will remain an active member.
Schuessler is a 21-year veteran of Wendy's and in 1995 was promoted to executive vice president, U.S. operations.
Wright joined the company in 1993 as president of the international division.
A company spokesman was not available to comment on who the previous president and COOs of U.S. and international operations were.
